Welcome to our bright and spacious apartment, perfectly located near Oslo Airport Gardermoen. The apartment has modern facilities and a cozy atmosphere, ideal for both short and long stays.

Possibility to add 2 extra beds that give a total of 6 beds.

With easy access to public transport and just a short drive from the airport, the apartment is ideal for travelers who want a convenient and comfortable base. 

We look forward to welcoming you!

Other things to note
The apartment is intended for 4 people, but 2 extra beds can be added, which gives a total of 6 beds. 

The water heater (102 liters) is intended for 4 people, so if more people are going to shower right after each other, this should be taken into account. Then a maximum of 3 min per person is recommended.

Otherwise, the apartment has all the equipment needed for 6 people.

There was plenty of parking, we arrived after dark and the pictures were helpful to find the space. Check-in was super easy and for a family our size, the price couldnt be beat. We would stay here again in a heartbeat.
